### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_document` | Read document text and structure for an app-authorized documentId, for example doc-fixture. | yes | no | auto |
| `create_document` | Create a blank document with a title, for example "Meeting notes". | no | no | ask |
| `insert_text` | Insert text at a UTF-16 index, for example index=1 and text="Hello". | no | no | ask |
| `replace_text` | Replace matching text, for example containsText.text="PLACEHOLDER", matchCase=true. | no | yes | deny |
| `delete_text` | Delete a UTF-16 index range, for example startIndex=1 and endIndex=3. | no | yes | deny |
| `insert_table` | Insert a table, for example rows=2, columns=2, location.index=1. | no | no | ask |
| `format_text` | Apply text style to a range. For bold text use textStyle.bold=true and fields="bold". | no | no | ask |
| `format_paragraph` | Apply paragraph style to a range. For a heading use namedStyleType="HEADING\_1" and fields="namedStyleType". | no | no | ask |
